observations.why: The 'we' pronoun enacts communal-sharing — an undifferentiated collective acting as one body, not a named individual deciding.
Proportionality framing — quantified benefit ratio and cost reduction cast the decision in cost/benefit terms.
The arrow notation enacts a directed migration order — a unilateral structural reallocation presented as decided, not proposed.
Quantified performance gain restated as a proportionality claim — benefit measured in a ratio.
A fixed deadline imposed as a scheduling allocation — temporal authority-ranking, a rank-based determination of when the collective must comply.
